forward_rowpacked64_cached.eligibility: 0 < q_seq == kv_seq <= 64; equal QK/value head widths; unfused_qk in {0,1,9}; plain path only

backward_query_two_pass.eligibility: the existing two-pass gate (unfused_qk 0/9, MHA or a qualified grouped geometry)

backward_query_dqunroll.eligibility: QK and value head dimension 128 inside the existing two-pass gate
backward_query_dqunroll.fallback: the original query shader; opt out with HIERARCHOS_ATTENTION_BACKWARD_QUERY_DQUNROLL=0

backward_query_scratchreuse.eligibility: the Phase XVIII query selector at head dimension 128; default on the qualified path
backward_query_scratchreuse.fallback: the Phase XVIII dQ-unroll shader, then the original query shader; opt out with HIERARCHOS_ATTENTION_BACKWARD_QUERY_SCRATCH_REUSE=0

backward_key_grouped.eligibility: MHA, plus 8q/2kv, 4q/2kv, 8q/4kv and 16q/4kv at head dimension 128

backward_key_channel4.fallback: the original two-pass key shader; opt out with HIERARCHOS_ATTENTION_BACKWARD_KEY_CHANNEL4=0

input_grad_output_tile32.eligibility: rows, input_dim and output_dim all multiples of 32
input_grad_output_tile32.fallback: the original linear_input_grad kernel; opt out with HIERARCHOS_LINEAR_INPUT_GRAD_OUTPUT_TILE=0

two_pass_requires: one key-range block (a split backward submission keeps the scalar kernel)
unfused_qk in {0, 9} for MHA, or one of the four measured grouped shapes at head dimension 128
channel4_requires: the two-pass gate admitted the geometry
row_packed_requires: equal QK and value head widths
no window, softcap, ALiBi, relative bias, dropout, sink, sparse mask, compressed keys, paged KV or value scale
query_order: query_dqunroll_scratchreuse when the Phase XVIII selector admits the geometry and the artifact loads
query_dqunroll when scratch reuse is disabled or its pipeline is refused
the original query shader when the dQ-unroll path is disabled or the geometry is not admitted
attention.fallback: the scalar backward and the generic forward for every ineligible geometry

linear_input_grad.mode: output-tiled 32 x 32, on by default for 32-aligned shapes
linear_input_grad.fallback: the original 16 x 16 linear_input_grad kernel for every other shape or an explicit 0

wmma.mode: full-fp16 (opt-in; global WMMA off by default)
c1_requires: packed element indices inside the 32-bit ceiling with one element of headroom
both bound operands cover every element the fast path reads
wmma.fallback: P3 module, selected automatically when any condition is unproven
wmma.override: none; no flag, environment variable or variant name selects a staging module
